important_correction: If lambda and mu are veh/h, the queue update is Q_next=max(0,Q+(lambda-mu)*Delta_t_hours), not Q+lambda-mu unless Delta_t=1 hour.
fdq_parameter_note: The archived expression mu=1679-12.09*Q used 12.09 directly. In the FDQ paper, mu=Cap-theta*Q with theta=w_b/phi. Therefore 12.09 should not automatically be interpreted as theta unless the density-to-queue conversion phi makes the units consistent.
